g.text: FIT · PERFORMANCE ENHANCEMENT · PART 4.4 OF 5 — PROTECTION & THE TOOLBOX
THE FIVE LEVERS ON ONE FLUID
water is the recurring villain. you don't chase it or starve it — you balance it.
LEVERS: Na · K · Mg · Ca · H2O
→ moves the ratio · a hard cut drops
same litre, wrong compartment = a different physique
core drains on a hard cut →
bloat · blood-volume · BP water — held down by the drain
shell swells = the smooth look that hides conditioning
wired BACKWARDS: float reads empty → drain CLAMPS, not opens
pink salt 1:1 iodised · ~500 mg Na / litre water · iodine = thyroid
a float valve wired backwards — the single most important idea
BP on cycle: tadalafil · telmisartan · nebivolol → keep the blood volume, control the pressure
magnesium ↔ calcium — opposite ends of one mechanism
they compete for the same binding sites — every rep rides this beam
raise until loose stool → back off
Mg also gates ATP, protein synthesis, sleep — the most under-dosed lever on the stand
the glycogen-geared fill valve — fills the core
GEAR RATIO ≈ 10 mg K per 1 g carb
both raise serum K · stacking them
risks the heart · food first · bloods
CUT SALT → ALDOSTERONE HIGH → YOU HOLD WATER.
STEADY SURPLUS → ALDOSTERONE LOW → YOU FLUSH.
Na : K : Mg : Ca — the diet re-proportions the levers
carbs raise the K share · keto raises Na + Mg
set yours from the plate, then sanity-check
YOU DON'T CHASE WATER OR STARVE IT — YOU REGULATE THE BALANCE.
nutrition & harm-reduction education, not medical advice · build ratios against your own bloodwork + a physician · kidney / cardiac history = extra caution
